logo:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: standalone Cheker app logomark, square PNG with genuine transparent background
Primary request: Create one compact distinctive abstract mark: a crisp check shape held inside an open segmented hexagonal C-shaped frame. This is a Linux application for checking MCP configuration integrity and reviewing suspicious instructions in files.
Style/medium: flat vector-like graphic with precise geometry and a strong silhouette that remains legible at small sizes; polished, restrained engineering brand.
Composition/framing: one centered standalone symbol occupying about 75 percent of a square canvas, generous transparent margin; no mockup and no surrounding objects.
Color palette: vivid restrained teal #24cba7 for the check and selected frame segments, pale silver #dce9ed for the remaining frame; flat solid colors.
Constraints: no lettering, no wordmark, no text, no watermark, no gradients, no shadows, no texture, no 3D. True transparent alpha background, not a painted checkerboard. The frame must stay visibly open and segmented. Exactly one final image.
hero:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: standalone wide 16:9 editorial brand illustration for Cheker, a restrained Italian developer product website
Primary request: A softly lit teal scanning plane crossing a small stack of translucent document sheets, suggesting careful inspection of configuration files. Create a sophisticated stylized 3D editorial image, with calm precision and tactile frosted glass.
Scene/backdrop: seamless very dark graphite navy #08151e background, subtle depth, restrained soft reflections.
Subject: stacked translucent document sheets suspended slightly apart, with delicate abstract line grooves only; a thin luminous teal #24cba7 scanning plane passes through the layers. The sheets are the only principal objects.
Composition/framing: landscape 16:9; visual mass weighted to the right two thirds; left third mostly quiet dark negative space. Slight isometric perspective and clear spacious composition. Entire stack fits comfortably in frame.
Lighting/mood: soft controlled studio lighting, gentle teal emission at the scan intersection, pale silver edge highlights, sophisticated engineering aesthetic.
Constraints: no text, no letters, no numbers, no code, no UI, no logos, no watermark. No padlocks, shields, skulls, robots, matrix rain, security clichés or dramatic laser beams. No claims of perfect protection. Exactly one final image.
